observations: Photo 0 shows the bell housing and torque converter of an automatic transmission with a metal pipe laid across the opening.
Photo 1 shows the side of a cast aluminum transmission casing with an unreadable white label and red paint marks.
Photo 2 shows the transmission separated from the torque converter, revealing internal gears and the converter hub.
All photos carry a "FIDEL AUTOS GLOBAL" watermark.
No brand, model, or part number is legible in any photo.

claims.evidence: M272 is not visible in any photo; M272 is a Mercedes engine code, not a gearbox code, so the seller's identification cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: Internal gears, clutches, or mechatronic unit may be worn or damaged.
risks.proof: Video of the input shaft rotating through gears, or close-up photos of internal clutch packs and valve body.

risks.risk: The unit may be incomplete (missing solenoids, sensors, or mechatronic).
risks.proof: Photo showing all included components laid out, or a written list of what is included.

risks.risk: Fitment is unknown; M272 is an engine code, so the compatible vehicle cannot be confirmed.
risks.proof: Readable photo of any part number plate or label on the casing.

risks.risk: Seals may leak or the torque converter may be damaged.
risks.proof: Leak test video or close-up of converter welds and seal areas.
risks.if_unproven: as needing seal or converter repair

proof_requests: A readable photo of any label, plate, or part number on the transmission casing.
A video showing the input shaft turning and gears engaging.
A photo showing all parts included with the gearbox.
response.reason: The item is clearly an automatic gearbox with torque converter, so it can be priced at its worst case as a non-working unit of unknown fitment; the M272 claim is unproven but does not prevent identification by type.
